pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "../interfaces/IEventEmitter.sol";

contract EventEmitter is IEventEmitter {
    error Unauthorized();
    error FactoryAlreadySet();

    address public factory;
    address private immutable _deployer;

    mapping(address => bool) public isAuthorizedEmitter;

    modifier onlyAuthorized() {
        if (!isAuthorizedEmitter[msg.sender] && msg.sender != factory) revert Unauthorized();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyFactory() {
        if (msg.sender != factory) revert Unauthorized();
        _;
    }

    constructor() {
        _deployer = msg.sender;
    }

    function setFactory(address factory_, address marketNFT_, address feeCollector_) external {
        if (msg.sender != _deployer) revert Unauthorized();
        if (factory != address(0)) revert FactoryAlreadySet();
        factory = factory_;
        isAuthorizedEmitter[factory_] = true;
        isAuthorizedEmitter[marketNFT_] = true;
        isAuthorizedEmitter[feeCollector_] = true;
    }

    function authorizeEmitter(address emitter) external onlyFactory {
        isAuthorizedEmitter[emitter] = true;
    }

    function revokeEmitter(address emitter) external onlyFactory {
        isAuthorizedEmitter[emitter] = false;
    }

    function adminAuthorizeEmitter(address emitter) external {
        if (msg.sender != _deployer) revert Unauthorized();
        isAuthorizedEmitter[emitter] = true;
    }

    function adminRevokeEmitter(address emitter) external {
        if (msg.sender != _deployer) revert Unauthorized();
        isAuthorizedEmitter[emitter] = false;
    }

    function emitMarketCreated(
        address pool,
        address token,
        uint256 nftId,
        address creator,
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol
    ) external onlyAuthorized {
        emit MarketCreated(
            pool,
            token,
            nftId,
            creator,
            name,
            symbol,
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function emitSwap(
        address pool,
        address sender,
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 newReserveUSID,
        uint256 newReserveToken,
        uint256 feeAmount
    ) external onlyAuthorized {
        emit Swap(
            pool,
            sender,
            tokenIn,
            tokenOut,
            amountIn,
            amountOut,
            newReserveUSID,
            newReserveToken,
            feeAmount,
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function emitFeeClaimed(
        address pool,
        uint256 nftId,
        address recipient,
        uint256 amount
    ) external onlyAuthorized {
        emit FeeClaimed(
            pool,
            nftId,
            recipient,
            amount,
            block.timestamp
        );
    }

    function emitFeeStrategyUpdated(
        uint256 nftId,
        FeeStrategy newStrategy
    ) external onlyAuthorized {
        emit FeeStrategyUpdated(
            nftId,
            newStrategy,
            block.timestamp
        );
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "../interfaces/IHLPMMFactory.sol";
import "../interfaces/IUSID.sol";
import "../interfaces/IMarketNFT.sol";
import "../interfaces/IFeeCollector.sol";
import "../interfaces/IEventEmitter.sol";
import "../interfaces/IHLPMMToken.sol";
import "./HLPMMPool.sol";
import "../tokens/HLPMMToken.sol";

contract HLPMMFactory is IHLPMMFactory {
    error MarketAlreadyExists();
    error InvalidName();
    error InvalidSymbol();

    uint256 public constant INITIAL_USID = 10_000 * 1e18;
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_TOKENS = 1_000_000_000 * 1e18;

    address public immutable usid;
    address public immutable eventEmitter;
    address public immutable marketNFT;
    address public immutable feeCollector;

    uint256 public marketCount;

    mapping(address => address) public tokenToPool;
    mapping(uint256 => address) public nftToPool;
    mapping(address => address) public poolToToken;
    mapping(address => uint256) public creatorNonce;
    
    address[] public allPools;

    constructor(
        address usid_,
        address eventEmitter_,
        address marketNFT_,
        address feeCollector_
    ) {
        usid = usid_;
        eventEmitter = eventEmitter_;
        marketNFT = marketNFT_;
        feeCollector = feeCollector_;
    }

    function createMarket(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        FeeStrategy initialStrategy
    ) external returns (address pool, address token, uint256 nftId) {
        if (bytes(name).length == 0) revert InvalidName();
        if (bytes(symbol).length == 0) revert InvalidSymbol();

        uint256 nonce = creatorNonce[msg.sender]++;
        
        bytes32 salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name, symbol, msg.sender, nonce));
        
        token = address(new HLPMMToken{salt: salt}());

        nftId = marketCount + 1;

        pool = address(new HLPMMPool(
            token,
            usid,
            address(this),
            feeCollector,
            eventEmitter,
            marketNFT,
            nftId
        ));

        if (tokenToPool[token] != address(0)) revert MarketAlreadyExists();

        IHLPMMToken(token).initialize(name, symbol, pool);

        IUSID(usid).mint(pool, INITIAL_USID);

        HLPMMPool(pool).initialize(INITIAL_USID, INITIAL_TOKENS);

        uint256 mintedNftId = IMarketNFT(marketNFT).mint(msg.sender, pool, initialStrategy);

        tokenToPool[token] = pool;
        nftToPool[nftId] = pool;
        poolToToken[pool] = token;
        allPools.push(pool);
        marketCount++;

        IEventEmitter(eventEmitter).authorizeEmitter(pool);

        IEventEmitter(eventEmitter).emitMarketCreated(
            pool,
            token,
            nftId,
            msg.sender,
            name,
            symbol
        );

        emit MarketCreated(pool, token, nftId, msg.sender);
    }

    function getPool(address token_) external view returns (address) {
        return tokenToPool[token_];
    }

    function computeTokenAddress(
        string memory name,
        string memory symbol,
        address creator,
        uint256 nonce
    ) external view returns (address) {
        bytes32 salt = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name, symbol, creator, nonce));
        
        bytes32 hash = keccak256(
            abi.encodePacked(
                bytes1(0xff),
                address(this),
                salt,
                keccak256(type(HLPMMToken).creationCode)
            )
        );
        
        return address(uint160(uint256(hash)));
    }

    function getAllPools() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return allPools;
    }

    function getPoolCount() external view returns (uint256) {
        return allPools.length;
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "./Math.sol";

library FeeCalculator {
    uint256 internal constant BASE_FEE = 30;           // 0.30% base fee
    uint256 internal constant MAX_FEE = 300;           // 3.00% max fee
    uint256 internal constant MIN_FEE = 10;            // 0.10% min fee
    uint256 internal constant FEE_DENOMINATOR = 10000; // basis points

    uint32 internal constant ONE_DAY = 1 days;
    uint32 internal constant ONE_WEEK = 7 days;
    uint32 internal constant ONE_MONTH = 30 days;

    uint256 internal constant HIGH_VOLATILITY_THRESHOLD = 500;   // 5% price change
    uint256 internal constant EXTREME_VOLATILITY_THRESHOLD = 1000; // 10% price change
    
    uint256 internal constant HIGH_CONCENTRATION_THRESHOLD = 1000;   // 10% held by top holder
    uint256 internal constant EXTREME_CONCENTRATION_THRESHOLD = 2500; // 25% held by top holder

    function calculateFee(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint32 poolAge,
        uint256 volatilityBps,
        uint256 topHolderBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 feeAmount, uint256 effectiveFeeBps) {
        int256 ageModifier = getAgeModifier(poolAge);
        int256 volModifier = getVolatilityModifier(volatilityBps);
        int256 concModifier = getConcentrationModifier(topHolderBps);

        int256 totalModifier = ageModifier + volModifier + concModifier;
        int256 rawFee = int256(BASE_FEE) + totalModifier;

        if (rawFee < int256(MIN_FEE)) {
            effectiveFeeBps = MIN_FEE;
        } else if (rawFee > int256(MAX_FEE)) {
            effectiveFeeBps = MAX_FEE;
        } else {
            effectiveFeeBps = uint256(rawFee);
        }

        feeAmount = (amountIn * effectiveFeeBps) / FEE_DENOMINATOR;
    }

    function getAgeModifier(uint32 poolAge) internal pure returns (int256 modifier_) {
        if (poolAge < ONE_DAY) {
            modifier_ = 50; // +0.50% for pools < 1 day old
        } else if (poolAge < ONE_WEEK) {
            modifier_ = 25; // +0.25% for pools < 1 week old
        } else if (poolAge < ONE_MONTH) {
            modifier_ = 10; // +0.10% for pools < 1 month old
        } else {
            modifier_ = 0;  // no modifier for mature pools
        }
    }

    function getVolatilityModifier(uint256 volatilityBps) internal pure returns (int256 modifier_) {
        if (volatilityBps >= EXTREME_VOLATILITY_THRESHOLD) {
            modifier_ = 100; // +1.00% for extreme volatility
        } else if (volatilityBps >= HIGH_VOLATILITY_THRESHOLD) {
            modifier_ = 50;  // +0.50% for high volatility
        } else if (volatilityBps >= 200) {
            modifier_ = 20;  // +0.20% for moderate volatility
        } else {
            modifier_ = 0;   // no modifier for low volatility
        }
    }

    function getConcentrationModifier(uint256 topHolderBps) internal pure returns (int256 modifier_) {
        if (topHolderBps >= EXTREME_CONCENTRATION_THRESHOLD) {
            modifier_ = 75;  // +0.75% for extreme concentration
        } else if (topHolderBps >= HIGH_CONCENTRATION_THRESHOLD) {
            modifier_ = 35;  // +0.35% for high concentration
        } else if (topHolderBps >= 500) {
            modifier_ = 15;  // +0.15% for moderate concentration
        } else {
            modifier_ = -10; // -0.10% for well-distributed tokens
        }
    }

    function calculateBaseFee(uint256 amountIn) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return (amountIn * BASE_FEE) / FEE_DENOMINATOR;
    }

    function getEffectiveFee(
        uint32 poolAge,
        uint256 volatilityBps,
        uint256 topHolderBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 effectiveFeeBps) {
        int256 ageModifier = getAgeModifier(poolAge);
        int256 volModifier = getVolatilityModifier(volatilityBps);
        int256 concModifier = getConcentrationModifier(topHolderBps);

        int256 rawFee = int256(BASE_FEE) + ageModifier + volModifier + concModifier;

        if (rawFee < int256(MIN_FEE)) {
            effectiveFeeBps = MIN_FEE;
        } else if (rawFee > int256(MAX_FEE)) {
            effectiveFeeBps = MAX_FEE;
        } else {
            effectiveFeeBps = uint256(rawFee);
        }
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

library Math {
    error MathOverflow();
    error MathDivisionByZero();

    function min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }

    function max(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a > b ? a : b;
    }

    function diff(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a > b ? a - b : b - a;
    }

    function sqrt(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (x == 0) return 0;
        
        z = x;
        uint256 y = (x + 1) / 2;
        
        while (y < z) {
            z = y;
            y = (x / y + y) / 2;
        }
    }

    function mulDiv(
        uint256 a,
        uint256 b,
        uint256 denominator
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
        if (denominator == 0) revert MathDivisionByZero();
        
        uint256 prod0;
        uint256 prod1;
        
        assembly {
            let mm := mulmod(a, b, not(0))
            prod0 := mul(a, b)
            prod1 := sub(sub(mm, prod0), lt(mm, prod0))
        }

        if (prod1 == 0) {
            return prod0 / denominator;
        }

        if (prod1 >= denominator) revert MathOverflow();

        uint256 remainder;
        assembly {
            remainder := mulmod(a, b, denominator)
            prod1 := sub(prod1, gt(remainder, prod0))
            prod0 := sub(prod0, remainder)
        }

        uint256 twos = denominator & (~denominator + 1);
        assembly {
            denominator := div(denominator, twos)
            prod0 := div(prod0, twos)
            twos := add(div(sub(0, twos), twos), 1)
        }

        prod0 |= prod1 * twos;

        uint256 inverse = (3 * denominator) ^ 2;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;
        inverse *= 2 - denominator * inverse;

        result = prod0 * inverse;
    }

    function mulDivRoundingUp(
        uint256 a,
        uint256 b,
        uint256 denominator
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
        result = mulDiv(a, b, denominator);
        if (mulmod(a, b, denominator) > 0) {
            if (result >= type(uint256).max) revert MathOverflow();
            result++;
        }
    }

    function ceilDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (b == 0) revert MathDivisionByZero();
        return a == 0 ? 0 : (a - 1) / b + 1;
    }

    function clamp(uint256 value, uint256 minVal, uint256 maxVal) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return min(max(value, minVal), maxVal);
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "./Math.sol";

library PoolMath {
    error InsufficientInputAmount();
    error InsufficientLiquidity();
    error InsufficientOutputAmount();

    uint256 internal constant PRECISION = 1e18;
    uint256 internal constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10000;

    function getAmountOut(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 reserveIn,
        uint256 reserveOut
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        if (amountIn == 0) revert InsufficientInputAmount();
        if (reserveIn == 0 || reserveOut == 0) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        uint256 numerator = amountIn * reserveOut;
        uint256 denominator = reserveIn + amountIn;
        amountOut = numerator / denominator;
    }

    function getAmountOutWithFee(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 reserveIn,
        uint256 reserveOut,
        uint256 feeBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountOut, uint256 feeAmount) {
        if (amountIn == 0) revert InsufficientInputAmount();
        if (reserveIn == 0 || reserveOut == 0) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        feeAmount = (amountIn * feeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;
        uint256 amountInAfterFee = amountIn - feeAmount;

        uint256 numerator = amountInAfterFee * reserveOut;
        uint256 denominator = reserveIn + amountInAfterFee;
        amountOut = numerator / denominator;
    }

    function getAmountIn(
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 reserveIn,
        uint256 reserveOut
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountIn) {
        if (amountOut == 0) revert InsufficientOutputAmount();
        if (reserveIn == 0 || reserveOut == 0) revert InsufficientLiquidity();
        if (amountOut >= reserveOut) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        uint256 numerator = reserveIn * amountOut;
        uint256 denominator = reserveOut - amountOut;
        amountIn = (numerator / denominator) + 1;
    }

    function getAmountInWithFee(
        uint256 amountOut,
        uint256 reserveIn,
        uint256 reserveOut,
        uint256 feeBps
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountIn, uint256 feeAmount) {
        if (amountOut == 0) revert InsufficientOutputAmount();
        if (reserveIn == 0 || reserveOut == 0) revert InsufficientLiquidity();
        if (amountOut >= reserveOut) revert InsufficientLiquidity();

        uint256 numerator = reserveIn * amountOut;
        uint256 denominator = reserveOut - amountOut;
        uint256 amountInBeforeFee = (numerator / denominator) + 1;
        
        amountIn = (amountInBeforeFee * BPS_DENOMINATOR) / (BPS_DENOMINATOR - feeBps);
        feeAmount = amountIn - amountInBeforeFee;
    }

    function calculatePriceImpact(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 reserveIn
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 impactBps) {
        if (reserveIn == 0) return BPS_DENOMINATOR;
        
        impactBps = (amountIn * BPS_DENOMINATOR) / (reserveIn + amountIn);
    }

    function getSpotPrice(
        uint256 reserveUSID,
        uint256 reserveToken
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 price) {
        if (reserveToken == 0) return 0;
        
        price = (reserveUSID * PRECISION) / reserveToken;
    }

    function getMarketCap(
        uint256 reserveUSID,
        uint256 reserveToken,
        uint256 totalTokenSupply
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 marketCap) {
        if (reserveToken == 0) return 0;
        
        uint256 pricePerToken = (reserveUSID * PRECISION) / reserveToken;
        marketCap = (pricePerToken * totalTokenSupply) / PRECISION;
    }

    function getK(uint256 reserveUSID, uint256 reserveToken) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return reserveUSID * reserveToken;
    }

    function quote(
        uint256 amountA,
        uint256 reserveA,
        uint256 reserveB
    ) internal pure returns (uint256 amountB) {
        if (amountA == 0) revert InsufficientInputAmount();
        if (reserveA == 0 || reserveB == 0) revert InsufficientLiquidity();
        
        amountB = (amountA * reserveB) / reserveA;
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

library TransferHelper {
    error TransferFailed();
    error TransferFromFailed();
    error ApproveFailed();

    function safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0xa9059cbb, to, amount) // transfer(address,uint256)
        );
        
        if (!success || (data.length > 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert TransferFailed();
        }
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0x23b872dd, from, to, amount) // transferFrom(address,address,uint256)
        );
        
        if (!success || (data.length > 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert TransferFromFailed();
        }
    }

    function safeApprove(address token, address spender, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(0x095ea7b3, spender, amount) // approve(address,uint256)
        );
        
        if (!success || (data.length > 0 && !abi.decode(data, (bool)))) {
            revert ApproveFailed();
        }
    }

    function safeTransferETH(address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        (bool success, ) = to.call{value: amount}("");
        if (!success) {
            revert TransferFailed();
        }
   }
}

import "../interfaces/IHLPMMRouter.sol";
import "../interfaces/IHLPMMFactory.sol";
import "../interfaces/IHLPMMPool.sol";
import "../interfaces/IERC20.sol";
import "../libraries/TransferHelper.sol";

contract HLPMMRouter is IHLPMMRouter {
    error Expired();
    error InvalidPath();
    error PoolNotFound();
    error InsufficientOutput();

    address public immutable factory;
    address public immutable usid;

    modifier ensure(uint256 deadline) {
        if (block.timestamp > deadline) revert Expired();
        _;
    }

    constructor(address factory_, address usid_) {
        factory = factory_;
        usid = usid_;
    }

    function swapExactTokensForTokens(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address tokenIn,
        address tokenOut,
        address to,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut);

        TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(tokenIn, msg.sender, pool, amountIn);

        amountOut = IHLPMMPool(pool).swap(tokenIn, amountIn, amountOutMin, to);
    }

    function swapExactTokensForTokensMultiHop(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address[] calldata path,
        address to,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        if (path.length < 2) revert InvalidPath();

        address firstPool = _getPool(path[0], path[1]);
        TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(path[0], msg.sender, firstPool, amountIn);

        amountOut = amountIn;
        
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
            address tokenIn = path[i];
            address tokenOut = path[i + 1];
            address pool = _getPool(tokenIn, tokenOut);
            
            bool isLastHop = (i == path.length - 2);
            address recipient = isLastHop ? to : _getPool(path[i + 1], path[i + 2]);
            
            uint256 minOut = isLastHop ? amountOutMin : 0;
            
            amountOut = IHLPMMPool(pool).swap(tokenIn, amountOut, minOut, recipient);
        }
    }

    function swapExactUSIDForTokens(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address tokenOut,
        address to,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address pool = IHLPMMFactory(factory).tokenToPool(tokenOut);
        if (pool == address(0)) revert PoolNotFound();

        TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(usid, msg.sender, pool, amountIn);

        amountOut = IHLPMMPool(pool).swap(usid, amountIn, amountOutMin, to);
    }

    function swapExactTokensForUSID(
        uint256 amountIn,
        uint256 amountOutMin,
        address tokenIn,
        address to,
        uint256 deadline
    ) external ensure(deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        address pool = IHLPMMFactory(factory).tokenToPool(tokenIn);
        if (pool == address(0)) revert PoolNotFound();

        TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(tokenIn, msg.sender, pool, amountIn);

        amountOut = IHLPMMPool(pool).swap(tokenIn, amountIn, amountOutMin, to);
    }

    function _getPool(address tokenA, address tokenB) internal view returns (address pool) {
        if (tokenA == usid) {
            pool = IHLPMMFactory(factory).tokenToPool(tokenB);
        } else if (tokenB == usid) {
            pool = IHLPMMFactory(factory).tokenToPool(tokenA);
        } else {
            revert InvalidPath();
        }
        
        if (pool == address(0)) revert PoolNotFound();
    }

    function getAmountsOut(
        uint256 amountIn,
        address[] calldata path
    ) external view returns (uint256[] memory amounts) {
        if (path.length < 2) revert InvalidPath();
        
        amounts = new uint256[](path.length);
        amounts[0] = amountIn;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < path.length - 1; i++) {
            address pool = _getPool(path[i], path[i + 1]);
            (uint256 reserveUSID, uint256 reserveToken) = IHLPMMPool(pool).getReserves();
            
            bool isUSIDIn = path[i] == usid;
            uint256 reserveIn = isUSIDIn ? reserveUSID : reserveToken;
            uint256 reserveOut = isUSIDIn ? reserveToken : reserveUSID;

            uint256 amountInWithFee = (amounts[i] * 9970) / 10000;
            amounts[i + 1] = (amountInWithFee * reserveOut) / (reserveIn + amountInWithFee);
        }
   }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

import "../interfaces/IHLPMMToken.sol";

contract HLPMMToken is IHLPMMToken {
    error Unauthorized();
    error AlreadyInitialized();
    error InsufficientBalance();
    error InsufficientAllowance();

    string public name;
    string public symbol;
    uint8 public constant decimals = 18;
    
    uint256 public constant INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1_000_000_000 * 1e18; // 1 billion tokens
    uint256 public totalSupply;

    address public pool;
    bool private _initialized;

    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;

    function initialize(
        string memory name_,
        string memory symbol_,
        address pool_
    ) external {
        if (_initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();
        
        name = name_;
        symbol = symbol_;
        pool = pool_;
        
        totalSupply = INITIAL_SUPPLY;
        balanceOf[pool_] = INITIAL_SUPPLY;
        
        _initialized = true;
        
        emit Transfer(address(0), pool_, INITIAL_SUPPLY);
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        return _transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        uint256 currentAllowance = allowance[from][msg.sender];
        
        if (currentAllowance != type(uint256).max) {
            if (currentAllowance < amount) revert InsufficientAllowance();
            allowance[from][msg.sender] = currentAllowance - amount;
        }

        return _transfer(from, to, amount);
    }

    function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, amount);
        return true;
    }

    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount) internal returns (bool) {
        if (balanceOf[from] < amount) revert InsufficientBalance();
        
        balanceOf[from] -= amount;
        balanceOf[to] += amount;
        
        emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
        return true;
   }
}
